messages.content: normalize.js is ready. It applies NFKC, lowercases, collapses whitespace to single spaces, and trims. I kept accents as required. tokenizer.js should call normalize then split on non-alphanumeric (including accented letters) while treating apostrophes as separators, and pipeline.js should build the exact output object. Let's coordinate on the split regex: use /[^a-z0-9]+/ after normalize, but note that apostrophes are separators, so they are included in the separator class. That yields don't -> don and t. Also ensure digits are kept. I'll review your files next round.
tokenizer.js implemented: tokenize normalizes via normalize, splits on non-ASCII-alphanumeric and apostrophes, no stopwords. Ready for peer review.
